plan.title: Finished jobs, waiting for a shipment
plan.body: Create a shipment per destination; split it across several if needed.

blocked.inspection_pending: Waiting for getpack's inspection before shipping
blocked.payment_pending: The customer has not paid the before-shipping instalment: you can prepare, not dispatch

plan.empty: No finished jobs waiting to ship

list.title: Your shipments
list.podMissing: Proof of delivery still to capture

create.title: Create shipment
create.subtitle: {jobNo} · {left} pcs ready to ship
create.splitHint: You can send part of it — the rest becomes another trip
create.fleetHint: Record a POD (photos + signature) on hand-over
create.getpack: Ask getpack to book a carrier
create.getpackHint: getpack sends a pickup slot · confirmed within 2 hours
create.getpackReason: The factory asked getpack to book a carrier when creating the shipment
create.submit: Create shipment + print {count, plural, one {# label} other {# labels}}
create.partly: {no} was created but the next step failed: {reason} — press again to continue

carrier.title: Request the fallback carrier
carrier.body: Your fleet cannot reach this address for {no}; getpack books a carrier and tells you.
carrier.reasonHint: E.g. outside the zones you deliver to
carrier.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. Our truck is not free today

pod.photoRequired: Take at least one photo of the delivery
pod.signatureRequired: Get the receiver's signature or typed name
pod.done: Delivery recorded — waiting for getpack's review
pod.photosHint: Photograph the goods where they were left
pod.signatureHint: Have the receiver sign in the box, or type their name
pod.submitHint: Evidence of delivery; the tolerance is judged on it
pod.receiverPlaceholder: Name of the person who signed

detail.blockedBody: The customer has not paid the before-shipping instalment; getpack tells you when it can go.
detail.carrierRequestedBody: Asked {at}: {reason} — getpack is booking the carrier and will confirm the pickup.
detail.podBody: Required for every delivery by your own fleet
detail.recipientNote: Recipient name, address and phone only

steps.label: 1. Label the cartons
steps.labelBody: One label per carton; the packing list travels with the goods
steps.sendBody: Send with your own truck, or ask getpack to book a carrier

tolerance.shortage_outside: Short beyond tolerance — getpack opens a claim
tolerance.detail: The whole order's result, once every trip of it is delivered

labels.title: Carton labels
labels.body: 100 × 150 mm, one per carton; set the label printer to this size first.
labels.notPacked: Not packed yet: the labels come when the shipment is ready
labels.waybillBody: The recipient's address is on the carrier's waybill

ready.action: Packed — make labels and packing list
ready.hint: getpack makes the carton labels and packing list for {no}

cancel.title: Cancel {no}
cancel.body: {no} is cancelled and its pieces go back to be shipped; this cannot be undone.
cancel.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. Customer asked to move the delivery

destination.confidential: getpack keeps the recipient's name, phone and address. The factory sees the destination code, the province and the postcode's first three digits.

waybill.note: The recipient's name, phone and address are on the carrier's waybill, which getpack sends to the carrier directly.
